```{r read csv}
sample_kills <- read.csv("./data/sample_kills.csv")
sample_rounds <- read.csv("./data/sample_rounds.csv")
```

```{r summary}
summary(sample_kills)
summary(sample_rounds)
```

```{r combine}
first_round_kill(sample_rounds, sample_kills)
```
